What we do

The studio

Tap for the details. Booking runs through the request builder below, Messenger, or a call.

Custom work is the whole point of the studio. Bring a finished idea or the start of one, and it gets drawn for you. The finished work in the book below spans color traditional pieces, black traditional, black and grey, and fine-detail color work.

The studio doubles as an art space and hosts events in-house, including the Bowser Ball tattoo fundraiser and art auction, where 100% of proceeds went to support an artist in the community. The poster shown here is the shop’s own event artwork.

Send your idea with the builder below, message the shop on Facebook, or call (814) 868-0666. The shop is also on Instagram at @sanctuarytattooerie, where its artists take bookings by DM.
